These agencies offer a wide range of services, including food, shelter, and healthcare, and work to address the root causes of poverty through programs like employment and life skills training. Their work is guided by faith and a commitment to helping the poor and vulnerable, with the goal of empowering individuals and families toward self-sufficiency.
